items.title: Data center proposal reaches Morley board Thursday
items.dek: Village of Morley trustees will hear a presentation on a proposed data center project at their Aug. 21 meeting, with agenda documents dated April 2025 and a separate presentation file posted this week.
items.findings: Agenda lists Item 4a Data Center Project document dated 4-21-25 | Separate Item 4a Data Center Presentation.pdf posted Aug. 25, 2025 | No acreage, megawatt, dollar or abatement figures appear in the public agenda listing | Agenda dated 08/21/2025
items.perspective: The board is scheduled to receive the presentation at the Aug. 21 meeting with public comment expected under standard meeting procedures.
